This Petition, Coming On For Orders This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that during pendency of the petition, the police after investigation have filed the charge-sheet and seeks leave of the Court to withdraw the petition,
reserving liberty to file fresh petition.
The said submission is placed on record.
The petition is dismissed as withdrawn, reserving liberty as prayed for.
